_comment: Every number here was measured, not estimated. Provenance is recorded per block.

feeMarket.l2BaseFeeNote: Median and mode across 60 blocks; Base sits pinned at its 5 mwei floor.
feeMarket.observedMeanEffectiveGasPriceNote: Mean across 120 sampled third-party USDC transfer txs. This is the AMBIENT population, not necessarily your relayer. Run tools/analyze-relayer.mjs to get your real figure.

gasPerPayment._source: test/GasBench.t.sol against real USDC on a Base fork; harness reproduces mainnet gas exactly

individual.note: Full transaction gas including intrinsic 21,000 and calldata. Verified equal to real mainnet receipts.

l1DataFeeWeiPerPayment._source: measured receipts for individual; GasPriceOracle.getL1Fee on realistic payloads for batches

workload._note: Stated by the team. newPayeeShare is an ASSUMPTION - measure it with tools/analyze-relayer.mjs.
